tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search products Jockey Delivery can bring from San Antonio stores. Read-only. Returns products (title, brand, price, image, availability, product url) and the store offer for each. To buy, use create_checkout (then confirm_checkout) once the shopper has chosen the item and given a delivery address;

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product by product_id (from search_catalog) or its delivery.jockeyvc.com url: description, images, variants, the store offer and delivery facts. Read-only.

tools.name: get_delivery_info
tools.description: Where Jockey Delivery delivers (San Antonio 782xx plus listed Bexar County ZIPs), the courier fee, the same-day order cutoff, and whether a given ZIP is served. Read-only.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a real order for one product delivered to the shopper's address. Re-checks price, shelf and delivery, then returns the review (item, address, exact total, delivery window, quote expiry) and a checkout_token. Show the shopper the review; if they accept, call confirm_checkout with the token to g

tools.name: confirm_checkout
tools.description: Call only after the shopper has seen and accepted the create_checkout review. Records their acceptance and returns checkout_url, a secure Stripe payment page. Give the shopper checkout_url; nothing is charged until they pay there. Refused if the quote expired (quote_expires_at) or the order details
